reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthening control of TB and HIV/AIDS in the Republic of Armenia - Armenia (01-Oct-2018-30-Sep-2021)

description.narrative: Armenia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Armenia (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce the burden of TB in Armenia by ensuring universal access to quality diagnosis and treatment of all forms of TB including M/XDR-TB through implementation of sustainable patient-centered community-based approaches addressing the needs.. Maintain low level of HIV epidemic and provide HIV treatment to all who need it.. The objectives of this program are: Ensure universal access to early and quality diagnosis of all forms of TB including M/XDR-TB. Ensure universal access to quality patient-centered treatment of all forms of TB including M/XDR-TB with appropriate patient support. Enhance the response to TB epidemic by strengthening involvement of communities, advocacy, communication and social mobilization. Strengthen the National TB Program management and improve the health system's performance for effective TB control. Scale up ART to reach 90% of those in need of treatment. Scale up HIV testing to ensure 75% of PLHIV know their status
